PS Nest 1.7.1 — Turning fix keeps order approvals

This update brings the Mac app up to date with the workshop: everything from 1.5.0, 1.6.0, 1.7.0 and 1.7.1.

1.7.1 — Turning fix keeps order approvals

  • "Nest again with turning allowed" now keeps an approved order confirmed: one click nests again and gives the files. In 1.7.0 the order had to be confirmed again first.
  • An order approval covers the parts, quantities and artwork. Letting a part turn on the sheet does not change it. Any other change (quantity, artwork, name, size) still needs the order confirmed again.
  • If a part must keep its grain, leave Turn unticked on it. When the files are held, choose "Keep this layout and record why" and the grain reason. Ticking Turn no longer asks for the order to be confirmed again.

1.7.0 — Nest guard

  • A nest with turning switched off is nested again with turning allowed. If turning would save a sheet, roll length or a bigger piece for stock, the print and cut files are held until you nest again with turning allowed or pick a real reason (grain, pattern, customer, machine).
  • "The job is double-sided" is not a reason. Tick Double-sided and choose the back artwork on the part row: one nest gives the FRONT print, the BACK print (mirrored to line up when the sheet is flipped) and the cut file.
  • The same parts nested before on the same material (a quote nest, an earlier try): if the earlier nest did better, the files are held until you open it, nest with its settings, or say why this layout is right.
  • A held job still shows the layout sheet and the report.

1.6.0 — Panels for oversized pieces

  • Printed pieces bigger than the sheet are split at their colour edges into butt-joined panels. Wide roll vinyl is split into overlapping panels.

1.5.0 — Workshop machines and combined orders

  • Export profiles for each cutter: Ameida, Biesse, CO2, Pulse, fibre laser and Gunner.
  • Combine several orders into one nest, with traceable labels and a worksheet for each order.
  • Vinyl rolls follow the job length, with a Roll left warning. Print PDFs are much smaller.

Your saved projects stay where they are. Finish any running nest before choosing Update and restart.
